targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  coalesce(nullif(clusters.name,''), clusters.id::text) AS "CLUSTER"

FROM clusters LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id=clusters.customer_id 
WHERE clusters.id::text = '$cluster'

SELECT 
coalesce(analytics->>'status', 'NO ANALYTICS') AS "STATUS"
FROM clusters LEFT JOIN flattened_analytics fa ON (clusters.id = fa.cluster_id) WHERE clusters.id='$cluster'

SELECT 
  clusters.version as "VERSION"
FROM clusters LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id=clusters.customer_id 
WHERE clusters.id::text = '$cluster'

SELECT 
COALESCE(analytics->>'license_status', 'Unknown') AS "LICENSED"
FROM clusters LEFT JOIN flattened_analytics fa ON (clusters.id = fa.cluster_id) WHERE clusters.id='$cluster'

SELECT
COALESCE(analytics->>'io_status', 'Unknown') AS "IO STATUS"
FROM flattened_analytics WHERE cluster_id = '$cluster'

SELECT 
EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - CAST(analytics->>'io_status_changed' AS timestamp))) as "UPTIME"
FROM clusters LEFT JOIN flattened_analytics fa ON (clusters.id = fa.cluster_id) WHERE clusters.id='$cluster'

SELECT
COALESCE(analytics->>'link_type', 'None') AS "LINK LAYER"
FROM flattened_analytics WHERE cluster_id = '$cluster'
SELECT count(*) AS "ALERTS" FROM alerts WHERE cluster_id = '$cluster' AND muted IS false

SELECT
CAST(coalesce(analytics->>'num_total_servers','0') AS integer) AS "TOTAL SERVERS"
FROM flattened_analytics WHERE cluster_id = '$cluster'

SELECT
CAST(COALESCE(analytics->>'num_total_servers','0') AS bigint) - CAST(COALESCE(analytics->>'num_servers_up','0') AS bigint) AS "OFFLINE"
FROM flattened_analytics WHERE cluster_id = '$cluster'

targets.expr: (sum(avg(rate({__name__=~"ops_driver.read_bytes|ops_driver.read_bytes_rdma",cluster_guid="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) by (node_id)) or vector(0)) + (sum(avg(rate({__name__=~"ops_driver.write_bytes|ops_driver.write_bytes_rdma",cluster_guid="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])) by (node_id)) or vector(0))

(sum(rate(label_replace({cluster_guid="$cluster", __name__=~"ops_driver.reads(_rdma)?"},"rdma", "$1", "__name__", "ops_driver.reads(_rdma)?")[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(label_replace({cluster_guid="$cluster", __name__=~"ops_driver.writes(_rdma)?"},"rdma", "$1", "__name__", "ops_driver.writes(_rdma)?")[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(label_replace({__name__=~"ops_driver.*_ops", cluster_guid="$cluster"}, "op","$1","__name__","ops_driver.(.*)_ops")[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))

targets.rawSql: select jsonb_path_query(usage_report,'$.*.rebuild.protectionState.numFailures')::text || ' Failures' as numFailures, jsonb_path_query(usage_report,'$.*.rebuild.protectionState.percent') as percent from usage_reports where cluster_id = '$cluster'

SELECT
  (fs ->> 'fs_id') AS fs_id,
  (
    (fs ->> 'used_total_capacity') :: float - (fs ->> 'used_metadata_capacity') :: float - (fs ->> 'used_ssd_readcache_capacity') :: float -(fs ->> 'used_ssd_writecache_capacity') :: float
  ) /(fs ->> 'total_capacity') :: float as obs_percentage_from_total
FROM
  cluster_analytics,
  jsonb_array_elements(data -> 'filesystems') AS fs
where
  category = 'fs'
  and cluster_id = '$cluster'

SELECT
  (fs->>'fs_id') AS fs_id,
  ((fs->>'used_total_capacity')::float - (fs->>'used_metadata_capacity')::float  -(fs->>'used_ssd_writecache_capacity')::float)/(fs->>'total_capacity')::float as obs_percentage_from_total
FROM
  cluster_analytics,
  jsonb_array_elements(data->'filesystems') AS fs
  where category = 'fs'
  and cluster_id = '$cluster'

list.definition:
SELECT coalesce(nullif(clusters.name,''), clusters.id::text) || '###' || clusters.id
 FROM clusters LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id=clusters.customer_id
 WHERE clusters.stats_enabled = true
 AND ($__timeFilter(clusters.last_seen) OR clusters.last_seen >= (NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hours' ))  AND (coalesce(customers.id,'00000000-00000000-00000000-00000000') = '$customer')
ORDER BY last_seen DESC
